conclusion: The migration from Microsoft SQL Server to PostgreSQL has been completed successfully for the BobsBookstore ADO .NET application. All 5 SQL statements have been identified, converted, and reintegrated into the codebase. The application builds successfully with 0 errors. While the DMS MCP tool encountered errors for all conversions, manual conversions were applied following PostgreSQL best practices and fully documented. The SQL Equivalency tool validated 1 statement as EQUIVALENT and returned UNKNOWN (marked as ERROR) for 4 statements due to their complexity. Runtime testing is recommended for the 4 statements with ERROR status to verify functional equivalence. All transformation definition requirements have been met, including passing every statement through both the DMS and SQL Equivalency tools, with comprehensive documentation of all results.
